statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and persistent dizziness that have significantly impacted daily activities.
CPT code 93226 (48-hour ambulatory electrocardiogram) is medically necessary to capture cardiac rhythm during symptomatic periods.
The service supports diagnoses R55 and R42.
The diagnosis codes are R55 and R42.
The denial reason code is PR-204.
The service is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan.
